build_swish_activation: build a PyTorch module that applies the Swish activation function x * sigmoid(x) to input tensors
create_swish_layer: create a Swish activation layer instance registered under ACTIVATION_LAYERS for use in neural network models
test_swish_forward: test the Swish forward pass by passing a torch.Tensor and verifying output equals x * sigmoid(x)
review_swish_implementation: review the Swish class implementation to confirm it correctly computes x * torch.sigmoid(x) in forward
refactor_swish_for_sigmoid_beta: refactor the Swish class to accept an optional beta parameter for the sigmoid input scaling
